title.description: Optional notification title (max 250 chars). Defaults to the application's Pushover label.

priority.description: Pushover priority: -2 (lowest, no notification), -1 (low / quiet), 0 (normal, default), 1 (high, bypass quiet hours), 2 (emergency — requires user acknowledgement).

url.description: Optional URL the notification's tap-action navigates to.

url_title.description: Anchor text shown for `url` (max 100 chars). Ignored when `url` is omitted.
